dedupe_keys.name: bornes de recharge pour vehicules electriques

description: Bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Électriques is a dataset listed in opendata.pau.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Extraction de la plateforme OpenStreetMap pour obtenir les bornes de recharges de véhicules électriques sur le territoire des Pyrénées Atlantiques. tag = amenity: chargingstation Il vous est possible d'améliorer la donnée en allant l'enrichir directement sur la plateforme OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Pau agglomeration. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are voiture, recharge, electrique, bornes, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 70 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-05-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-pau-fr-portal.
